test_MessageToString: test text_format.MessageToString to serialize a protobuf message to human-readable text format
test_Merge: test text_format.Merge to parse human-readable text format into a protobuf message
test_MessageToString_as_one_line: test text_format.MessageToString with as_one_line=True to print nested messages on a single line
test_Merge_exotic_types: test text_format.Merge parsing exotic types like int64, uint64, doubles, and escape sequences
test_Tokenizer_ConsumeByteString: test text_format._Tokenizer ConsumeByteString to parse and validate byte string tokens from text
